tools.name: list_ocr_models
tools.description: List available OCR definitions and installation state on this execution Node. Set installed_only to list installed models. This does not install, remove, enable or select a model.

tools.name: install_ocr_model
tools.description: Install the exact OCR model ID from list_ocr_models only when the user requests installation. This uses the shared Node installer and permission policy. Keep the immutable definition; do not silently select a model or repeat a denied or uncertain installation.

locales.ja: OCR モデルをインストール

tools.name: uninstall_ocr_model
tools.description: Uninstall the exact OCR model ID only when the user requests removal. This removes installed assets, not the model definition, settings or attachments. Do not automatically repeat a denied or uncertain removal.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List a directory in the session worktree. An empty path selects the root. Pass the returned cursor to read another page.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

cursor.description: Use null for the first page; otherwise pass the exact cursor from the previous result

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read UTF-8 lines from files up to 64 MiB in the session worktree. offset is zero-based and defaults to 0; limit defaults to 200; responses return at most 2000 lines. Each page is bounded to 128 KiB. Results include one-based line numbers, the full file revision and next_offset for another page. Keep the returned line text exactly, including newlines, when preparing edit_file. A page is partial evidence; do not treat it as the whole file.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

limit.description: Requested rows; each response has an independent output budget and may return a continuation

icon.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ><path d="M12 7v14" /><path d="M3 18a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 4 4 0 0 1 4-4h5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v13a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" /></svg>

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a complete UTF-8 file up to 128 KiB. Pass the revision from read_file to replace a file, or null to create a new file without replacing an existing entry. Missing parent directories are created for new files. A conflict requires reading the current file before another edit. Prefer edit_file for partial changes and larger files.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

expected_revision.description: Revision from read_file, or null to create a new file

icon.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ><path d="M15 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7Z" /><path d="M14 2v4a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h4" /><path d="M10 9H8" /><path d="M16 13H8" /><path d="M16 17H8" /></svg>

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 file using its full revision from read_file. Provide old_text and new_text for one replacement, or edits for up to 128 replacements in the same file; the two forms are mutually exclusive. Every old_text is matched against the original file and must occur exactly once unless its replace_all is true. Overlapping matches, missing text or stale revisions fail without writing any change. Each fragment is limited to 128 KiB and files to 64 MiB. Preserve exact whitespace and line endings; a conflict requires reading the current file before another edit.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

icon.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ><path d="M15 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7Z" /><path d="M14 2v4a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h4" /><path d="M10 9H8" /><path d="M16 13H8" /><path d="M16 17H8" /></svg>

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Move a regular file to the execution Node's Trash using its current revision. Does not permanently delete files or delete directories. A conflict requires reading the current file before retrying.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move a regular file to another path in the same worktree using its current revision. The destination parent must exist and the destination must be absent; never overwrite an existing entry. A conflict requires inspecting both paths before retrying.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

destination.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create one directory in an existing parent within the session worktree. An existing directory is unchanged; an existing file or symbolic link is a conflict. Missing parents are not created automatically.

path.description: Relative to the session worktree, with forward slashes

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find regular file paths by worktree-relative globs within path (default root), respecting .gitignore and never following symlinks. * does not cross /; **/* includes root and nested files. For the N most recently modified files, use globs=["**/*"] and limit=N. Results are newest first, with a stable path order for equal modification times. limit defaults to 500; responses return at most 500 paths; request next_offset for another page. Partial scans have no continuation: narrow path before retrying. No shell approval is needed.

path.description: Worktree-relative file or directory; empty or . selects the root

limit.description: Requested rows; each response has an independent output budget and may return a continuation

icon.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"> <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/> <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/> </svg>

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search UTF-8 files with embedded ripgrep matching within path (a file or directory, default worktree root), respecting .gitignore and never following symlinks. mode selects content rows (default), matching file paths, or matching line counts. In content rows, matched=true identifies matching lines; matched=false identifies neighboring context lines. context requests lines before and after each match; type uses ripgrep language names such as rust, js, and python. multiline permits matches across newlines. limit defaults to 200; responses return at most 200 rows, including context rows. Use next_offset for another complete-scan page. Scans have a 20-second deadline and a 64 MiB per-file bound; diagnostics identify skipped large files or incomplete scans. Incomplete scans have no continuation: narrow path before retrying. Lines longer than 16 KiB are explicitly marked truncated. No shell approval is needed.

query.description: Non-empty text or regular expression to search inside files; globs only filter which files are searched

path.description: Worktree-relative file or directory; empty or . selects the root

limit.description: Requested rows; each response has an independent output budget and may return a continuation

type.description: A ripgrep file type name such as rust, js, or python

tools.name: read_office
tools.description: Read DOCX/PDF text, XLSX cell values and formulas, or PPTX slide text and notes from a worktree path or an attachment visible in this conversation. Use source.kind "path" with a worktree-relative path, or "attachment" with its attachment ID. Earlier attachments must belong to completed, failed or cancelled turns still visible in this conversation; queued or running future inputs are unavailable. Images and scanned PDF pages use OCR when an OCR model is installed on the Node. File sources return the revision for edits. Follow next offsets to read every section, including continuations of long parts.

value.description: Worktree-relative path or visible conversation attachment ID

offset.description: Zero-based section offset. Long document parts continue in subsequent sections.

tools.name: read_notebook
tools.description: Read numbered nbformat 4 cells without executing a kernel. Use next_offset to continue. Returned cell JSON retains source, metadata and saved outputs; truncated cells omit oversized content and include a bounded source preview.

limit.description: Requested rows; each response has an independent output budget and may return a continuation

tools.name: edit_notebook
tools.description: Apply a revision-checked atomic batch to nbformat 4 cells. Replace changes only source and retains the cell ID, metadata and saved outputs. Insert creates a cell with a new ID; delete removes a cell. Zero-based indices refer to the original notebook; multiple inserts at the same index preserve batch order. Read the current revision first. No kernel is executed.

dev.sailry.platform.instructions: Use read_file to capture the current revision before editing, moving or deleting a file. For several changes in one file, send one edit_file edits array; every match is located in the original content and the batch is saved once. Use replace_all only when every occurrence should change. Keep exact whitespace and line endings. A conflict requires reading the current file before retrying. Use create_directory and move_file for workspace file organization; delete_file moves regular files to Trash. These tools never replace an existing move destination or delete a directory. For file discovery and content search, use find_files and search_files rather than running shell commands. Scope path first, honor next_offset, and treat partial scans as incomplete: narrow path instead of claiming offset can advance an interrupted scan.
